problems_addressed.specific_problem: Struggling to balance family life with real estate business demands

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Lack of organized systems and processes in business

problems_addressed.specific_problem: High stress and anxiety impacting personal and professional life
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Implement daily personal time for decompression and focus on small, consistent actions to reduce stress.

episode_summary: In this episode, Julia Linquist shares her challenges in balancing a high-performing real estate career with family life. Michael Opyd provides actionable advice on improving business systems, delegating tasks, and focusing on high-value transactions to reduce stress and enhance productivity. Listeners will gain insights into managing personal and professional demands effectively.
